subject: Post-discovery: align ML infra runbook + 60–90m immersion — timezone & slot check
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sean O'Leary <sean@veridian.ai>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + next step: 60–90m ML/infra immersion — timezone check

Hey Sean — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (2 min):
- Goal: validate production path for model serving (latency <= 150ms p95) and KV/prefix caching strategy for your streaming prompt workloads.
- Success criteria you mentioned: reproducible cost estimates, audit log access, and a short roll-forward plan to pilot in a dedicated pool.

Next step: Technical immersion (recommended 60–90 minutes) with our ML infra engineer and ops lead to walk through runbook, sample traffic, and a short deployment demo. Attendees we suggest: your ML lead, one infra/platform engineer, procurement (for any contract questions).

To make scheduling easy, can you confirm which timezone you prefer we show slots in? You were on PST today but team is split across PST/EST. I dumped a few candidate windows below in PST — if you prefer EST or CET I’ll reformat and send an invite.

Candidate windows (PST):
- Wed Dec 2, 10:00–11:30 (60–90m)
- Thu Dec 3, 14:00–15:30 (60–90m)
- Fri Dec 4, 09:00–10:30 (60–90m)

I also attached a short SOW draft and my one-page prep notes (attachment names below). If any of the slots work, I’ll lock it and loop in the right internal owners. If none fit, tell me a few times that do and I’ll sync attendees.

Prep / ask before the session:
- A short sample of typical batch sizes and peak tokens/sec (anonymized) — helps us pick batching/quantization routes.
- Any compliance constraints (SOC2, data residency) to confirm the Private vs Dedicated path.

Attachments: 20261201-veridian-sow-draft.pdf (draft), veridian_precall_notes.md

Thanks — I’ll stand by for timezone preference and preferred slot.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: 20261201-veridian-sow-draft.pdf

Thanks Michael — good summary. We want to move forward with the immersion. A couple quick notes: 

- Preferred timezone: EST (most of the infra org is on the East coast).
- Attendees confirmed so far: me, Priya Rao (ML Lead), and Daniel Cook (Infra). Procurement (procurement@veridian.ai) asked to be looped for calendar invite and SOW.

Availability (EST):
- Thu Dec 3: 17:00–18:30 EST (this maps to Thu 14:00–15:30 PST in your list) — this slot should work for the ML lead.
- If that fills, we can do Mon Dec 7: 11:00–12:30 EST.

We can also accept an invite that shows EST times. Can you send an invite and include the SOW in the invite so procurement has it on the calendar?

Looking forward to the demo.

—Sean

Tentative agenda (60–75m):
- 0–5m: quick intros and goals check (Michael + Sean)
- 5–20m: Veridian architecture + traffic profile (Sean / Priya)
- 20–45m: Redwood runbook walkthrough — serving runtime, caching strategy, and fallback policies (Mina)
- 45–60m: Deployment demo + quantization/throughput tradeoffs (Rishi)
- 60–75m: Q&A and next steps / pilot proposal (all)

Mina — any specific artifacts you need ahead of the call (sample shapes, peak tokens/sec, example prompt prefixes)? If yes, I will ask Veridian to share anonymized samples.

Procurement — attaching SOW draft here for review prior to the invite. If you need a revised signature block or billing contact, let me know we can update.

Attaching: 20261201-veridian-sow-draft.pdf

I will send the invite now (shows EST) and include a Calendly fallback link in case we need to move it.

—Michael
